messages:
katie_cs: FYI — Skyward's renewal is 2027-08-15. Their token usage dropped ~65% this billing cycle and procurement just messaged about a competitive demo. Need quick triage and owner for next steps.

omar_se: Do we have any backend errors or increased 5xx in their logs? Could be an SDK issue.

katie_cs: Good call. I'm pulling their usage.csv now, but quick snapshot:
```
week_start, tokens
2027-03-01, 1_200_000
2027-03-08, 1_100_000
2027-03-15, 600_000
2027-03-22, 420_000
```

rachel_account: Heads-up — their champion (Tom) left last month. New contact is Julia Park (Head of ML). Procurement is running a vendor bake-off, Lexicon AI is doing an on-site demo next week.

omar_se: On our side I'm not seeing an uptick in errors for their API key. No rollout or model change flagged on their org. Could be decreased user activity or feature toggles. Any chance they shifted from hosted to a self-hosted cache?

katie_cs: They didn't self-host. They are on Hosted API with caching enabled. No config changes recorded in our audit logs since Feb.

devx_eng: Quick idea — sometimes teams throttle upstream queries in the app when a new budget owner arrives. Can we ask Julia if they changed budget or rate limits?

ben_revops: If this is procurement-driven, we should surface a retention offer and a product-led win: 1) run a focused enablement session for the new ML lead, 2) propose a short-term commitment at a discounted rate to lock throughput, 3) demo our embeddings + vector store connectors. I can put together a one-pager.

katie_cs: Agreed. Plan proposal:
- Owner: @katie_cs coordinate 
- Tech checks: @omar_se validate there's no silent degradation + prepare quick runbook for common client issues
- Enablement: @devx_eng prepare a 45-min workshop + sample notebooks tailored to their integration (embedding search + reranking)
- Commercial: @ben_revops draft a 30-day retention offer and competitive counter-proposal
- Account update: @rachel_account mark renewal risk = high and capture new stakeholders

omar_se: I'll check their request logs and client HTTP metrics, plus validate model IDs used. ETA 2 hours.

devx_eng: Will assemble a condensed enablement deck and a repo with 2 runnable examples by EOD.

ben_revops: Drafting retention options now. If procurement is scheduling a demo with Lexicon, we should offer a joint technical deep-dive with their ML team.

katie_cs: Scheduling check-in: 30-min sync with Julia + procurement + our SEs. calendar-bot: Please find a slot Friday 11:00-11:30 PT and invite @omar_se @devx_eng @ben_revops @rachel_account.

calendar-bot: Meeting scheduled: Fri 2027-03-26 11:00-11:30 PT — "Skyward: renewal/usage triage". Invited: katie_cs, omar_se, devx_eng, ben_revops, rachel_account, julia.

rachel_account: I'll send a quick pre-read to Julia and procurement with usage snapshot + suggested agenda. Also confirming whether Lexicon pitched any specific feature (vector DB bundling, lower latencies).

katie_cs: If anyone gets procurement messaging before the call, drop it here. Primary goal: stop downward momentum + re-engage new decision-maker.

omar_se: Update: no 5xx, but I see a spike in 429s for a specific endpoint from their traffic on 2027-03-18 — looks like client-side retries/backoff misconfigured. Will include mitigation steps in the runbook.

devx_eng: Add to enablement: retry/backoff best practices and batching tips; also a short demo showing cost/latency tradeoffs for quantized variant.

ben_revops: I'll also prepare a short comparison sheet vs Lexicon focusing on integration lift and SLA history.

katie_cs: Great. Marking thread as active. Next update here after logs + pre-read sent. :thumbsup:
